newsitem.title: USA: Tech rally powers Nasdaq through 1600, new record.
newsitem.headline: Tech rally powers Nasdaq through 1600, new record.

text.p: A broad technology rally pushed the Nasdaq composite index through the 1600 mark on Monday in its fourth consecutive record close.
The Nasdaq Composite Index gained 11.10 points or 0.70 percent to close unofficially at 1605.43. The index has added 100 points in less than a month and 200 points since May 27.
The rally extended from networking companies to chip stocks and computer companies, traders said.

"There's just nothing for sale. Technology is the future and people just want to own them and hold on to them. Intel's leading the group. Networkers are also strong ahead of Cisco's earnings tomorrow," one trader said.

Networking equipment maker Cisco Systems Inc, which is expected to post fourth quarter earnings on Tuesday, gained 1-13/16 to 81-5/8. The American Stock Exchange's networking index gained 5.21 points or 1.55 percent to 341.19.

Intel Corp, the most active Nasdaq issue, gained 3-1/8 to 96-3/4, leading a surge in other chips companies. The Philadelphia Stock Exchange semiconductor index added 9.42 points or 2.50 percent to 386.61. Xilinx Inc gained 3-13/16 to 52-13/16 on growing optimism after it hosted a meeting last week with industry analysts, analysts said.
